name: shakshi
description: Shakshi · A Commitment for Complete Rest. Storefront (frontend), API and studio (backend), and shared domain code.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
